resolution.plan: The Task Planner, Question Solver, Semantic Judger and two-step Numerical Judger templates are printed with [Example] placeholders that the paper fills with two examples randomly sampled per knowledge concept from MathKnowCT (Sec. Dataset Overview). Fill the placeholders with two seeded-random labelled examples per concept from the public MathKnowCT (Li et al. 2024a), run all agents with gpt-4o-2024-05-13 (numerical judger at temperature 0.7, generated Python executed locally), and compute accuracy over the ~2,400 concept-question pairs (Table 1 counts).
resolution.approximation: Different random demonstrations; the paper adjusts prompt text per LLM without printing the variants; per-concept counts under 100 make n approximate.
